CheckTitle: IMDSv2 is not required for EC2 instances at account level
Description: Instance Metadata Service Version 2 (IMDSv2) is not required by default for all EC2 instances on the account level.
Risk: Not requiring the use of IMDSv2 for metadata access, EC2s are not protected by it against Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks, a web vulnerability where an attacker tricks a server into making unintended requests to resources. IMDSv2 requires the use of a session token to access instance metadata, making it more secure than IMDSv1, which does not have this additional layer of protection.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure IMDSv2 is enforced by default for all EC2 instances, and make sure any existing EC2 instances have also been configured appropriately.
